items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: That's so. He was a good drummer. A good, solid, good, solid beat.

ctx.x: It really should be Contrell. They usually call it Contrell. That's it, Contrell. He wasn't old in those days, but he has a son now, so they usually speak of him as old man Contrell. Contrell. Uh, Baby took a few lessons from him. Natty Dominick started as a drummer with a few lessons from Contrell.

That's so. He was a good drummer. A good, solid, good, solid beat. Good right and left hand. And, uh, when I heard that band, I, uh, I, I'll tell you, I was so excited I couldn't sleep. It was the greatest.
Was it different than the other Chicago bands?
